name: emulate
description: Emulates various features on the selected page.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Set to "No emulation" to disable. If omitted, conditions remain unchanged.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Set the rate to 1 to disable throttling. If omitted, throttling remains unchanged.

geolocation.description: Geolocation to emulate. Set to null to clear the geolocation override.

userAgent.description: User agent to emulate. Set to null to clear the user agent override.

colorScheme.description: Emulate the dark or the light mode. Set to "auto" to reset to the default.

deviceScaleFactor.description: Specify device scale factor (can be thought of as dpr).

isMobile.description: Whether the meta viewport tag is taken into account. Defaults to false.

hasTouch.description: Specifies if viewport supports touch events. This should be set to true for mobile devices.

isLandscape.description: Specifies if viewport is in landscape mode. Defaults to false.

viewport.description: Viewport to emulate. Set to null to reset to the default viewport.
